profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | React • TypeScript • Node.js • AWS | Claude’s Best Friend
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer at Moody’s Analytics, building data tools that banks, asset managers, and insurers use to assess risk and capital. 

I work across the stack in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS. I like owning the problems that slow whole teams down. I found a CI/CD workaround that was bloating pull requests across the org, researched a native AWS fix, and led the meetings that got DevOps and our Core platform team to adopt it. I also led the org-wide GitHub Merge Queue rollout, which cut end-of-sprint deploys from hours to 30 minutes.

On the backend, I’m co-leading a full migration from PostgreSQL to ClickHouse, moving our analytics workloads to a columnar database built for that scale. I’ve also built services and routes, debugged auth issues, and designed custom user types on ABAC. I own accessibility compliance for three production apps. For the past two years I’ve also built prompt orchestration and agentic LLM workflows.

I mentor engineers on my team in code review and technical decisions, and in handling feedback along with navigating some of the harder days.

Core stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, AWS, AG-Grid, GitHub Actions, LLM/agentic workflows

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Digital Content & Innovations - Screening & Benchmarking | 2025 – Present | New York, NY (Remote – San Diego, CA)

Full-stack engineer building data visualization, backend, and CI/CD infrastructure for financial data products used by banks, hedge funds, asset managers, insurers, and government agencies.
Rated Outperform (2025) for technical excellence, feature delivery, and utilizing AI workflows.

 · Co-leading a full migration from PostgreSQL to ClickHouse, moving analytics workloads to a columnar database built for scale
 · Built and scaled React/AG-Grid data grids rendering 1M+ financial records across deeply nested hierarchical sectors, with average render times under 10 seconds
 · Built and maintained backend services for Screener, including XLS export and record-level tagging; debugged authentication issues and designed custom ABAC user types for granular data permissions across client accounts
 · Identified a flawed cross-team CI/CD workaround, researched a native AWS webhook path-filtering fix, and drove its adoption with DevOps leadership and the Core platform team
 · Researched and implemented a parallelized GitHub Merge Queue architecture and led its org-wide rollout, cutting end-of-sprint CI/CD cycles from up to 6 hours to 30 minutes
 · Sole engineering owner of accessibility compliance for three production applications, cutting violations from 10 to under 5 per page across 100+ components

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Analytics & Integration | 2021 – 2025 | New York, NY (Remote – San Diego, CA)
 
· As part of a multi-engineer effort to merge two legacy commercial real estate platforms (Reis and Catalyst) into a single consolidated product, Moody's OneView, extended an inherited microservice pattern from 5 services to 30+, each shaping and transforming data for specific AG-Grid and Highcharts visualizations (KPIs, inventory trends, financial reporting views), and implemented the RESTful API contracts between the presentation layer and backend.
· Developed and packaged core React analytics features into framework-agnostic Web Components, embedding them into a legacy Angular v1 application to modernize UI without a full infrastructure rewrite
· Delivered high-priority client integrations, directly accelerating institutional sales cycles and contributing to a team-wide 5% performance bonus multiplier
positions.insights: Software Design, Web Engineering and +3 skills

positions.title: Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
Creating web applications using technologies like Javascript, CSS, HTML, ReactJS, MongoDB, SQL, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, and collaborating with teams on Git and GitHub

•	HTML, CSS Javascript Web Development
•	React, React Hooks, Node, NodeJS, Front End Deployment
•	ExpressJS, API development, Mongoose/MongoDB, Back End Deployment
•	GitHub/ Git collaboration

positions.title: Information Technology Manager/ Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Build and Deploy in house network with security and firewalls
•	Handle all IT Support issues (Frontend/Backend) 
•	Maintain HIPPA compliance for data storage and internal/external communications
•	Front End Web Development and Deployment (Wordpress, Joomla, PHP, React, Javascript)
•	Back End Development and Server Management (Apache, myPHPadmin)
•	Assist marketing team with integrations into CRMs and Automated Marketing software – HubSpot, Infusionsoft, and HighRise
•	Manage all cloud systems including Amazon AWS (Virtual computing and cloud storage), Google Suite Admin, Office365 Admin, GoDaddy Admin, CRMs, and CMS systems
•	Building new email platforms for marketing purposes as well as being the admin for all communications systems within the company

positions.title: Laser Technician
positions.description:
Operated Fobagraph Laser Machines that ran on CAD and C++.

Programmed Industrial Automated Laser Engraving and Etching Machines using C++ to match customer designs.
Ensured smooth operation of 3 machines to keep up with production demands.
